note: Hungary, read in Act XC of 2023 on the general rules for the entry and stay of third-country nationals, on Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (the government's legal database, net.jogtar.hu) on 2026-10-30. The Hungarian Card is a residence permit for work under an employment relationship (or as a company's owner or officer doing actual work); beyond those with a listed higher qualification, it may be granted to a professional sportsperson or coach, a performing artist (előadóművész), or one working for a registered film producer. It is valid for at most three years and may be extended by up to three years at a time; it is read as tied to the employment it rests on. EU and EEA citizens, and those whom agreements between the EU and third countries give equal rights of free movement (Switzerland, the game's reading of that clause), have the right of free movement and residence under the separate Act I of 2007, not read. Where the card is applied for isn't in the sections read ('either' is the game's reading); its fee and decision time, the national settlement permit and naturalisation's count aren't written; the Immigration and Asylum Office's site answered with a captcha.
